metadata.fuenteOficial: La Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días · Edición Canónica de 15 Libros

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 1: La Visión de Lehi y las Planchas de Bronce
capitulos.textoOriginal:
1. I, Nephi, having been born of goodly parents, therefore I was taught somewhat in all the learning of my father; and having seen many afflictions in the course of my days, nevertheless, having been highly favored of the Lord in all my days; yea, having had a great knowledge of the goodness and the mysteries of God, therefore I make a record of my proceedings in my days.
14. And it came to pass that when my father had read and seen many great and marvelous things, he did exclaim many things unto the Lord; such as: Great and marvelous are thy works, O Lord God Almighty! Thy throne is high in the heavens, and thy power, and goodness, and mercy are over all the inhabitants of the earth; and, because thou art merciful, thou wilt not suffer those who come unto thee that they shall perish!
20. And when the Jews heard these things they were angry with him; yea, even as with the prophets of old, whom they had cast out, and stoned, and slain; and they also sought his life, that they might take it away. But behold, I, Nephi, will show unto you that the tender mercies of the Lord are over all those whom he hath chosen, because of their faith, to make them mighty even unto the power of deliverance.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I, Nephi, having been born of goodly parents...

traducciones.es:
1. Yo, Nefi, habiendo nacido de buenos padres, recibí por tanto alguna instrucción en toda la ciencia de mi padre; y habiendo conocido muchas aflicciones en el curso de mis días, muy favorecido del Señor en todos mis días.
14. ¡Grandes y maravillosas son tus obras, oh Señor Dios Todopoderoso! Tu trono está en las alturas de los cielos, y tu poder, y bondad, y misericordia se extienden sobre todos los habitantes de la tierra.
20. Pero he aquí, yo, Nefi, os mostraré que las entrañables misericordias del Señor se extienden sobre todos aquellos que él ha escogido, a causa de su fe, para hacerlos poderosos hasta el poder mismo de la liberación.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 2: Lehi Sale con su Familia al Desierto
capitulos.textoOriginal:
2. And it came to pass that the Lord commanded my father, even in a dream, that he should take his family and depart into the wilderness.
4. And it came to pass that he departed into the wilderness. And he left his house, and the land of his inheritance, and his gold, and his silver, and his precious things, and took nothing with him, save it were his family, and provisions, and tents, and departed into the wilderness.
16. And it came to pass that I, Nephi, being exceedingly young, nevertheless being large in stature, and also having great desires to know of the mysteries of God, wherefore, I did cry unto the Lord; and behold he did visit me, and did soften my heart that I did believe all the words which had been spoken by my father; wherefore, I did not rebel against him like unto my brothers.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And it came to pass that the Lord commanded my father, even in a dream...

traducciones.es:
2. Y aconteció que el Señor mandó a mi padre, aun en un sueño, que tomase a su familia y partiese para el desierto.
4. Y aconteció que salió para el desierto. Y dejó su casa, y la tierra de su herencia, y su oro, y su plata, y sus cosas preciosas, y partió para el desierto.
16. Y aconteció que yo, Nefi... teniendo grandes deseos de conocer los misterios de Dios, clamé por tanto al Señor; y he aquí que él me visitó y ablandó mi corazón.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 3: «Iré y Haré»: El Mandamiento de Obtener las Planchas
capitulos.textoOriginal:
7. And it came to pass that I, Nephi, said unto my father: I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded, for I know that the Lord giveth no commandments unto the children of men, save he shall prepare a way for them that they may accomplish the thing which he commandeth them.
15. But behold I said unto them that: As the Lord liveth, and as we live, we will not go down unto our father in the wilderness until we have accomplished the thing which the Lord hath commanded us.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded...

traducciones.es:
7. Y sucedió que yo, Nefi, dije a mi padre: Iré y haré lo que el Señor ha mandado, porque sé que el Señor nunca da mandamientos a los hijos de los hombres sin prepararles una vía para que puedan cumplir lo que les ha mandado.
15. Mas he aquí, yo les dije que: Así como el Señor vive, y nosotros vivimos, no descenderemos hasta nuestro padre en el desierto antes de haber cumplido lo que el Señor nos ha mandado.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 4: Nefi Guiado por el Espíritu Obtiene las Planchas
capitulos.textoOriginal:
6. And I was led by the Spirit, not knowing beforehand the things which I should do.
14. And now, when I, Nephi, had heard these words, I remembered the words of the Lord which he spake unto me in the wilderness, saying that: Inasmuch as thy seed shall keep my commandments, they shall prosper in the land of promise.
38. And it came to pass that we took the plates of brass and the servant of Laban, and departed into the wilderness, and journeyed unto the tent of our father.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And I was led by the Spirit, not knowing beforehand...

traducciones.es:
6. E iba guiado por el Espíritu, no sabiendo de antemano lo que tendría que hacer.
14. En cuanto los de tu posteridad guarden mis mandamientos, prosperarán en la tierra de promisión.
38. Y aconteció que tomamos las planchas de bronce y al siervo de Labán, y partimos para el desierto, a la tienda de nuestro padre.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 5: El Gozo de Saríah y el Valor de las Escrituras
capitulos.textoOriginal:
8. And she spake, saying: Now I know of a surety that the Lord hath commanded my husband to flee into the wilderness; yea, and I also know of a surety that the Lord hath protected my sons, and delivered them out of the hands of Laban, and given them power whereby they could accomplish the thing which the Lord hath commanded them. And after this manner of language did she speak.
21. And we had obtained the records which the Lord had commanded us, and searched them and found that they were desirable; yea, even of great worth unto us, insomuch that we could preserve the commandments of the Lord unto our children.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Now I know of a surety that the Lord hath commanded my husband...

traducciones.es:
8. Ahora sé con certeza que el Señor ha mandado a mi esposo huir al desierto; sí, y sé que el Señor ha protegido a mis hijos.
21. Y vimos que eran deseables; sí, de gran valor para nosotros, de manera que pudimos conservar los mandamientos del Señor para nuestros hijos.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 6: El Propósito Sagrado: Persuadir a Venir a Cristo
capitulos.textoOriginal: 4. For the fulness of mine intent is that I may persuade men to come unto the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, and be saved.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: For the fulness of mine intent is that I may persuade men...

traducciones.es: 4. Porque la plenitud de mi intento es persuadir a los hombres a que vengan al Dios de Abraham, y al Dios de Isaac, y al Dios de Jacob, y sean salvos.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 7: La Invitación a la Familia de Ismael y el Perdón
capitulos.textoOriginal:
12. Yea, and how is it that ye have forgotten that the Lord is able to do all things according to his will, for the children of men, if it so be that they exercise faith in him? Wherefore, let us be faithful to him.
21. And it came to pass that I did frankly forgive them all that they had done, and I did exhort them that they would pray unto the Lord their God for forgiveness. And it came to pass that they did so. And after they had done praying unto the Lord we did again travel on our journey towards the tent of our father.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: How is it that ye have forgotten that the Lord is able to do all things...

traducciones.es:
12. ¿Cómo es que habéis olvidado que el Señor tiene poder para hacer todas las cosas según su voluntad, para los hijos de los hombres, si es que ejercen la fe en él?
21. Y aconteció que les perdoné sinceramente cuanto me habían hecho.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 8: El Árbol de la Vida y la Barra de Hierro
capitulos.textoOriginal:
10. And it came to pass that I beheld a tree, whose fruit was desirable to make one happy.
12. And as I partook of the fruit thereof it filled my soul with exceedingly great joy; wherefore, I began to be desirous that my family should partake of it also; for I knew that it was desirable above all other fruit.
19. And I beheld a rod of iron, and it extended along the bank of the river, and led to the tree by which I stood.
30. But, to be short in writing, behold, he saw other multitudes pressing forward; and they came and caught hold of the end of the rod of iron; and they did press their way forward, continually holding fast to the rod of iron, until they came forth and fell down and partook of the fruit of the tree.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And I beheld a tree, whose fruit was desirable to make one happy...

traducciones.es:
10. Y aconteció que vi un árbol cuyo fruto era deseable para hacer a uno feliz.
12. Y al comer de su fruto, llenó mi alma de un gozo inmenso; por lo que deseé que mi familia también comiese de él.
19. Y vi una barra de hierro, la cual se extendía a lo largo de la ribera del río y conducía al árbol.
30. Y avanzaron a través del vapor de tinieblas, asidos a la barra de hierro, hasta que llegaron y comieron del fruto del árbol.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 9: Las Planchas para un Fin Sabio en el Señor
capitulos.textoOriginal:
5. Wherefore, the Lord hath commanded me to make these plates for a wise purpose in him, which purpose I know not.
6. But the Lord knoweth all things from the beginning; wherefore, he prepareth a way to accomplish all his works among the children of men; for behold, he hath all power unto the fulfilling of all his words. And thus it is. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The Lord hath commanded me to make these plates for a wise purpose in him...

traducciones.es:
5. Mas el Señor me ha mandado hacer estas planchas para un fin sabio para él, fin que yo no sé.
6. Pero el Señor sabe todas las cosas desde el principio; por tanto, él prepara una vía para cumplir todas sus obras.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 10: Profecías del Mesías y el Bautismo en el Jordán
capitulos.textoOriginal:
6. Wherefore, all mankind were in a lost and in a fallen state, and ever would be save they should rely on this Redeemer.
18. For he is the same yesterday, today, and forever; and the way is prepared for all men from the foundation of the world, if it so be that they repent and come unto him.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And the way is prepared for all men from the foundation of the world...

traducciones.es:
6. Todo el género humano se hallaba en un estado perdido y caído, y lo estaría para siempre, a menos que confiase en este Redentor.
18. Porque él es el mismo ayer, hoy y para siempre; y la vía está preparada para todos los hombres desde la fundación del mundo, si es que se arrepienten y vienen a él.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 11: La Condescendencia de Dios y el Amor Supremo
capitulos.textoOriginal:
17. And I said unto him: I know that he loveth his children; nevertheless, I do not know the meaning of all things.
21. And the angel said unto me: Behold the Lamb of God, yea, even the Son of the Eternal Father! Knowest thou the meaning of the tree which thy father saw?
22. And I answered him, saying: Yea, it is the love of God, which sheddeth itself abroad in the hearts of the children of men; wherefore, it is the most desirable above all things.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Behold the Lamb of God, yea, even the Son of the Eternal Father!...

traducciones.es:
17. Sé que ama a sus hijos; no obstante, no sé el significado de todas las cosas.
21. ¡He aquí el Cordero de Dios, sí, el Hijo del Padre Eterno!
22. Sí, es el amor de Dios que se derrama ampliamente en el corazón de los hijos de los hombres; por tanto, es de todas las cosas la más deseable.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 12: Visión de la Venida de Cristo a las Américas
capitulos.textoOriginal:
6. And I saw the heavens open, and the Lamb of God descending out of heaven; and he came down and showed himself unto them.
10. And these twelve ministers whom thou beholdest shall judge thy seed. And, behold, they are righteous forever; for because of their faith in the Lamb of God their garments are made white in his blood.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And I saw the heavens open, and the Lamb of God descending...

traducciones.es:
6. Y vi abrirse los cielos, y al Cordero de Dios que descendía del cielo; y bajó y se manifestó a ellos.
10. Y son justos para siempre; porque a causa de su fe en el Cordero de Dios, sus vestidos son blanqueados en su sangre.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 13: La Restauración de las Verdades Claras y Preciosas
capitulos.textoOriginal: 40. And the angel spake unto me, saying: These last records, which thou hast seen among the Gentiles, shall establish the truth of the first, which are of the twelve apostles of the Lamb, and shall make known the plain and precious things which have been taken away from them; and shall make known to all kindreds, tongues, and people, that the Lamb of God is the Son of the Eternal Father, and the Savior of the world; and that all men must come unto him, or they cannot be saved.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And they shall make known to all kindreds, tongues, and people...

traducciones.es: 40. Y manifestarán a todas las tribus, lenguas y pueblos que el Cordero de Dios es el Hijo del Eterno Padre y el Salvador del mundo; y que es necesario que todos los hombres vengan a él, o no podrán ser salvos.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 14: La Victoria de los Santos Armados con Rectitud
capitulos.textoOriginal: 14. And it came to pass that I, Nephi, beheld the power of the Lamb of God, that it descended upon the saints of the church of the Lamb, and upon the covenant people of the Lord, who were scattered upon all the face of the earth; and they were armed with righteousness and with the power of God in great glory.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And they were armed with righteousness and with the power of God...

traducciones.es: 14. Y aconteció que yo, Nefi, vi descender el poder del Cordero de Dios sobre los santos de la iglesia del Cordero... y estaban armados con rectitud y con el poder de Dios en gran gloria.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 15: Aferrarse a la Palabra de Dios para Vencer al Enemigo
capitulos.textoOriginal:
24. And I said unto them that it was the word of God; and whoso would hearken unto the word of God, and would hold fast unto it, they would never perish; neither could the temptations and the fiery darts of the adversary overpower them unto blindness, to lead them away to destruction.
25. Wherefore, I, Nephi, did exhort them to give heed unto the word of the Lord; yea, I did exhort them with all the energies of my soul, and with all the faculty which I possessed, that they would give heed to the word of God and remember to keep his commandments always in all things.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Whoso would hearken unto the word of God, and would hold fast unto it...

traducciones.es:
24. Y les dije que quienes escucharan la palabra de Dios y se aferraran a ella, no perecerían jamás; ni los dardos encendidos del adversario podrían subyugarlos hasta cegarlos, para llevarlos a la destrucción.
25. Por tanto, yo, Nefi, los exhorté a que prestasen atención a la palabra del Señor con todas las energías de mi alma.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 16: La Liahona y las Grandes Cosas por Medios Pequeños
capitulos.textoOriginal:
10. And it came to pass that as my father arose in the morning, and went forth to the tent door, to his great astonishment he beheld upon the ground a round ball of curious workmanship; and it was of fine brass. And within the ball were two spindles; and the one pointed the way whither we should go into the wilderness.
28. And it came to pass that I, Nephi, beheld the pointers which were in the ball, that they did work according to the faith and diligence and heed which we did give unto them.
29. And there was also written upon them a new writing, which was plain to be read, which did give us understanding concerning the ways of the Lord; and it was written and changed from time to time, according to the faith and diligence which we gave unto it. And thus we see that by small means the Lord can bring about great things.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And thus we see that by small means the Lord can bring about great things...

traducciones.es:
10. Y vio sobre el suelo una esfera de bronce fino... y en la esfera había dos agujas que marcaban el camino.
28. Y vi que las agujas funcionaban de acuerdo con la fe, diligencia y atención que les dábamos.
29. Y así vemos que por medios pequeños el Señor puede realizar grandes cosas.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 17: El Mandamiento de Construir el Barco y la Fe Inquebrantable
capitulos.textoOriginal:
8. And it came to pass that the Lord spake unto me, saying: Thou shalt construct a ship, after the manner which I shall show thee, that I may carry thy people across these waters.
13. And I will also be your light in the wilderness; and I will prepare the way before you, if it so be that ye shall keep my commandments; wherefore, inasmuch as ye shall keep my commandments ye shall be led towards the promised land; and ye shall know that it is by me that ye are led.
50. And I said unto them: If God had commanded me to do all things I could do them. If he should command me that I should say unto this water, be thou earth, it should be earth; and if I should say it, it would be done.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: If God had commanded me to do all things I could do them...

traducciones.es:
8. Construirás un barco, según la manera que yo te mostraré, para que yo lleve a tu pueblo a través de estas aguas.
13. Y seré vuestra luz en el desierto; y prepararé el camino delante de vosotros, si es que guardáis mis mandamientos.
50. Si Dios me hubiera mandado hacer todas las cosas, yo podría hacerlas.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 18: La Travesía del Océano y la Llegada a la Tierra Prometida
capitulos.textoOriginal:
3. And I, Nephi, did go into the mount oft, and I did pray oft unto the Lord; wherefore the Lord showed unto me great things.
23. And it came to pass that after we had sailed for the space of many days we did arrive at the promised land; and we went forth upon the land, and did pitch our tents; and we did call it the promised land.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And we did arrive at the promised land; and we went forth...

traducciones.es:
3. Y yo, Nefi, subía con frecuencia al monte, y con frecuencia oraba al Señor; por lo que el Señor me manifestó grandes cosas.
23. Y aconteció que después que hubimos navegado por el espacio de muchos días, llegamos a la tierra de promisión; y plantamos nuestras tiendas.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 19: El Sufrimiento y Amorosa Bondad del Redentor
capitulos.textoOriginal:
9. And the world, because of their iniquity, shall judge him to be a thing of naught; wherefore they scourge him, and he suffereth it; and they smite him, and he suffereth it. Yea, they spit upon him, and he suffereth it, because of his loving kindness and his long-suffering towards the children of men.
10. And the God of our fathers, who were led out of Egypt, out of bondage, and also were preserved in the wilderness by him, yea, the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, yieldeth himself, according to the words of the angel, as a man, into the hands of wicked men, to be lifted up, according to the words of Zenock, and to be crucified, according to the words of Neum, and to be buried in a sepulchre, according to the words of Zenos, which he spake concerning the three days of darkness, which should be a sign given of his death unto those who should inhabit the isles of the sea, more especially given unto those who are of the house of Israel.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And the world, because of their iniquity, shall judge him to be a thing of naught...

traducciones.es:
9. Y el mundo, a causa de su iniquidad, lo juzgará como cosa de ningún valor; por tanto, lo azotan, y él lo soporta; y lo hieren, y él lo soporta... por motivo de su amorosa bondad y su longanimidad para con los hijos de los hombres.
10. Y el Dios de nuestros padres se entrega a sí mismo como hombre en manos de hombres inicuos, para ser levantado y ser crucificado.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 20: El Señor Purifica en el Horno de la Aflicción
capitulos.textoOriginal:
10. For, behold, I have refined thee, I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
12. Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called, for I am he; I am the first, and I am also the last.
18. O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments—then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: For, behold, I have refined thee, I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction...

traducciones.es:
10. He aquí, te he purificado, mas no con plata; te he escogido en el horno de la aflicción.
12. Escúchame, oh Jacob: Yo soy él; yo soy el primero, y yo soy también el postrero.
18. ¡Oh, si hubieras atendido a mis mandamientos! Entonces tu paz habría sido como un río, y tu justicia como las olas del mar.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 21: «En las Palmas de mis Manos te Tengo Grabada»
capitulos.textoOriginal:
15. For can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee, O house of Israel.
16. Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
23. And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers; they shall bow down to thee with their face towards the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord; for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands...

traducciones.es:
15. ¿Puede una mujer olvidar a su niño de pecho? ¡Sí, ellas pueden olvidar, pero yo no me olvidaré de ti, oh casa de Israel!
16. He aquí, en las palmas de mis manos te tengo grabada; tus muros están continuamente delante de mí.
23. Y sabrás que yo soy el Señor; porque no serán avergonzados los que esperan en mí.

capitulos.capitulo: Primer Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 22: El Santo de Israel Protege y Apacienta a los Justos
capitulos.textoOriginal:
17. Wherefore, he will preserve the righteous by his power, even if it so be that the fulness of his wrath must come, and the righteous be preserved, even unto the destruction of their enemies by fire. Wherefore, the righteous need not fear; for thus saith the prophet, they shall be saved, even if it so be as by fire.
24. And the time cometh speedily that the righteous must be led up as calves of the stall, and the Holy One of Israel must reign in dominion, and might, and power, and great glory.
28. But, behold, all nations, kindreds, tongues, and people shall dwell safely in the Holy One of Israel if it so be that they will repent.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Wherefore, the righteous need not fear... and there shall be one fold and one shepherd.

traducciones.es:
17. Por tanto, preservará a los justos por su poder... Por tanto, los justos no tienen por qué temer.
24. Y él apacentará a sus ovejas, y en él hallarán pasto; y habrá un rebaño y un pastor.
28. Y todos los pueblos morarán seguros en el Santo de Israel, si es que se arrepienten.

capitulos.capitulo: Segundo Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 1: Las Bendiciones y Exhortaciones Finales de Lehi
capitulos.textoOriginal:
14. Awake! and arise from the dust, and hear the words of a trembling parent, whose limbs ye must soon lay down in the cold and silent grave, from whence no traveler can return; a few more days and I go the way of all the earth.
23. Awake, my sons; put on the armor of righteousness. Shake off the chains with which ye are bound, and come forth out of obscurity, and arise from the dust.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Awake, my sons; put on the armor of righteousness. Shake off... (Second Book of Nephi 1)

traducciones.es:
14. ¡Despertad, hijos míos; vestíos con la armadura de la rectitud! Sacudíos las cadenas con que estáis atados, y salid de la obscuridad, y levantaos del polvo.
23. ¡Despertad, hijos míos; levantaos y no seáis más oprimidos!

capitulos.capitulo: Segundo Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 2: El Albedrío, la Caída y la Redención por el Santo Mesías
capitulos.textoOriginal:
6. Wherefore, redemption cometh in and through the Holy Messiah; for he is full of grace and truth.
25. Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might have joy.
27. Wherefore, men are free according to the flesh; and all things are given them which are expedient unto man. And they are free to choose liberty and eternal life, through the great Mediator of all men, or to choose captivity and death, according to the captivity and power of the devil; for he seeketh that all men might be miserable like unto himself.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might ha... (Second Book of Nephi 2)

traducciones.es:
6. Por tanto, la redención viene en y por medio del Santo Mesías, porque él es lleno de gracia y de verdad.
25. Adán cayó para que los hombres existiesen; y existen los hombres para que tengan gozo.
27. Así pues, los hombres son libres según la carne; y les son dadas todas las cosas que para ellos son menester. Y son libres para escoger la libertad y la vida eterna, por medio del gran Mediador de todos los hombres, o escoger la cautividad y la muerte.

capitulos.capitulo: Segundo Libro de Nefi · Capítulo 3: Las Profecías de José en Egipto sobre los Últimos Días

And we did magnify our office unto the Lord, taking upon us the responsibility, answering the sins of the people upon our own heads if we did not teach them the word of God with all diligence; wherefore, by laboring with our might their blood might not come upon our garments; otherwise their blood would come upon our garments, and we would not be found spotless at the last day.

capitulos.textoOriginal:

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: King Benjamin thought it was expedient... to take the names... (Book of Mosiah 6)

capitulos.textoOriginal:
19. Therefore, lift up your heads, and rejoice, and put your trust in God, in that God who was the God of Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob; and also, that God who brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, and caused that they should walk through the Red Sea on dry ground, and fed them with manna that they might not perish in the wilderness; and many more things did he do for them.

19. ¡Oh pueblo mío, alzad la cabeza y consolaos; porque he aquí, el tiempo está cerca, o no está muy lejos, en que no estaremos ya más sujetos a nuestros enemigos!
33. Si os volvéis al Señor con íntegro propósito de corazón, y ponéis vuestra confianza en él, y le servís con toda diligencia de mente, él os librará de la servidumbre.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
13. Now Ammon said unto him: I can assuredly tell thee, O king, of a man that can translate the records; for he has wherewith that he can look, and translate all records that are of ancient date; and it is a gift from God. And whosoever is commanded to look in them, the same is called seer.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: A seer is a revelator and a prophet also; and a gift which i... (Book of Mosiah 8)

13. Un vidente es revelador y profeta también; y un don mayor que éste no puede tener hombre alguno.
16. Y así un vidente es capaz de conocer cosas pasadas y futuras, y por este conducto todas las cosas serán reveladas.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 9: El Registro de Zeniff: La Salida de Zarahemla
capitulos.textoOriginal:
1. I, Zeniff, having been taught in all the language of the Nephites, and having had a knowledge of the land of Nephi, or of the land of our fathers' first inheritance, and having been sent as a spy among the Lamanites that I might spy out their forces, that our army might come upon them and destroy them—but when I saw that which was good among them I was desirous that they should not be destroyed.
17. Yea, in the strength of the Lord did we go forth to battle against the Lamanites; for I and my people did cry mightily to the Lord that he would deliver us out of the hands of our enemies, for we were awakened to a remembrance of the deliverance of our fathers.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I, Zeniff, having been taught in all the language of the Nep... (Book of Mosiah 9)

traducciones.es:
1. Yo, Zeniff, habiendo sido instruido en todo el idioma de los nefitas... salí de la tierra de Zarahemla para poseer la tierra de Lehi-Nefi.
17. Sí, con la fuerza del Señor salimos a la batalla contra los lamanitas; porque yo y mi pueblo clamamos fuertemente al Señor para que nos librase.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 10: La Victoria de Zeniff y el Odio Heredado de los Lamanitas
capitulos.textoOriginal:
10. And it came to pass that we did go up to battle against the Lamanites; and I, even I, in my old age, did go up to battle against the Lamanites. And it came to pass that we did go up in the strength of the Lord to battle.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And we did go up in the strength of the Lord to battle again... (Book of Mosiah 10)

traducciones.es:
10. Y subimos con la fuerza del Señor a la batalla contra los lamanitas... y los herimos con gran mortandad.
19. Y yo y mi pueblo volvimos a entrar en nuestras tierras y a apacentar nuestros rebaños.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 11: La Maldad del Rey Noé y la Misión del Profeta Abinadí
capitulos.textoOriginal:
20. And it came to pass that there was a man among them whose name was Abinadi; and he went forth among them, and began to prophesy, saying: Behold, thus saith the Lord, and thus hath he commanded me, saying, Go forth, and say unto this people, thus saith the Lord—Wo be unto this people, for I have seen their abominations, and their wickedness, and their whoredoms; and except they repent I will visit them in mine anger.
29. Now the eyes of the people were blinded; therefore they hardened their hearts against the words of Abinadi, and they sought from that time forward to take him. And king Noah hardened his heart against the word of the Lord, and he did not repent of his evil doings.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Wo be unto this generation! And the Lord said unto me: Stret... (Book of Mosiah 11)

traducciones.es:
20. Y aconteció que vino entre ellos un hombre cuyo nombre era Abinadí; y comenzó a profetizar entre ellos, diciendo: He aquí, así dice el Señor: ¡Ay de este pueblo, porque he visto sus abominaciones!
29. Y aconteció que el rey Noé endureció su corazón contra la palabra del Señor, y no se arrepintió de sus malas obras.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 12: Abinadí Comparece Atado ante el Rey Noé y sus Sacerdotes
capitulos.textoOriginal:
1. And it came to pass that after the space of two years that Abinadi came among them in disguise, that they knew him not, and began to prophesy among them, saying: Thus has the Lord commanded me, saying—Abinadi, go and prophesy unto this my people, for they have hardened their hearts against my words; they have repented not of their evil doings; therefore, I will visit them in my anger, yea, in my fierce anger will I visit them in their iniquities and abominations.
34. I am the Lord thy God, who hath brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I will cause this people to know that I am the Lord their Go... (Book of Mosiah 12)

capitulos.textoOriginal:
5. Now it came to pass after Abinadi had spoken these words that the people of king Noah durst not lay their hands on him, for the Spirit of the Lord was upon him; and his face shone with exceeding luster, even as Moses' did while in the mount of Sinai, while speaking with the Lord.
28. And moreover, I say unto you, that salvation doth not come by the law alone; and were it not for the atonement, which God himself shall make for the sins and iniquities of his people, that they must unavoidably perish, notwithstanding the law of Moses.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And now, when Abinadi had spoken these words, his face shone... (Book of Mosiah 13)

traducciones.es:
5. Y su rostro resplandecía con un brillo extraordinario, tal como el de Moisés mientras estaba en el monte de Sinaí.
28. Y además, os digo que la salvación no viene por la sola ley de Moisés; y si no fuese por la expiación que Dios mismo hará por los pecados e iniquidades de su pueblo, éste inevitablemente perecería.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
3. He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief; and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

3. Despreciado y desechado entre los hombres; varón de dolores y experimentado en quebranto.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 15: Dios Mismo Descenderá para Redimir a su Pueblo
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: God himself shall come down among the children of men, and s... (Book of Mosiah 15)

18. ¡Cuán hermosos son sobre los montes los pies de aquel que trae buenas nuevas, que publica la paz!

capitulos.textoOriginal:
7. And if Christ had not risen from the dead, or have broken the bands of death that the grave should have no victory, and that death should have no sting, there could have been no resurrection.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The grave hath no victory, and the sting of death is swallow... (Book of Mosiah 16)

traducciones.es:
7. De modo que si Cristo no hubiese resucitado de los muertos... no habría podido haber resurrección.
8. Mas hay una resurrección; por tanto, el sepulcro no tiene victoria, y el aguijón de la muerte es absorbido en Cristo.
9. Él es la luz y la vida del mundo; sí, una luz que es infinita, que nunca se puede extinguir.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
2. But there was one among them whose name was Alma, he also being a descendant of Nephi. And he was a young man, and he believed the words which Abinadi had spoken, for he knew concerning the iniquity which Abinadi had testified against them; therefore he began to plead with the king that he would not be angry with Abinadi, but suffer that he might depart in peace.

2. Mas hubo uno entre ellos cuyo nombre era Alma... y creyó en las palabras que Abinadí había hablado.

20. Y habiendo dicho estas palabras, cayó Abinadí, habiendo sufrido la muerte por fuego; sí, ejecutado por negarse a retractar los mandamientos de Dios.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
8. And it came to pass that he said unto them: Behold, here are the waters of Mormon (for thus were they called) and now, as ye are desirous to come into the fold of God, and to be called his people, and are willing to bear one another's burdens, that they may be light;
9. Yea, and are willing to mourn with those that mourn; yea, and comfort those that stand in need of comfort, and to stand as witnesses of God at all times and in all things, and in all places that ye may be in, even until death, that ye may be redeemed of God, and be numbered with those of the first resurrection, that ye may have eternal life—

30. And now it came to pass that all this was done in Mormon, yea, by the waters of Mormon, in the forest that was near the waters of Mormon; yea, the place of Mormon, the waters of Mormon, the forest of Mormon, how beautiful are they to the eyes of them who there came to the knowledge of their Redeemer; yea, and how blessed are they, for they shall sing to his praise forever.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And they were called the church of God, or the church of Chr... (Book of Mosiah 18)

8. He aquí las aguas de Mormón... y ya que deseáis entrar en el redil de Dios y ser llamados su pueblo, y estáis dispuestos a llevar las cargas los unos de los otros para que sean ligeras;
9. y estáis dispuestos a llorar con los que lloran; sí, y a consolar a los que necesitan de consuelo, y ser testigos de Dios en todo tiempo y en todas las cosas...
14. Alma tomó a Helam... y dijo: Helam, yo te bautizo, teniendo autoridad del Dios Todopoderoso, como testimonio de que has hecho convenio de servirle hasta que mueras.
30. ¡Oh, cuán hermosas eran a los ojos de aquellos que allí llegaron al conocimiento de su Redentor! Sí, y ¡cuán benditas son!

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Mosíah · Capítulo 19: La Muerte del Rey Noé y la Subyugación de Límni
capitulos.textoOriginal:
11. Now it came to pass that the king commanded them that all the men should leave their wives and their children, and flee before the Lamanites.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The king commanded that all the men should leave their wives... (Book of Mosiah 19)

11. El rey les mandó que todos los hombres abandonasen a sus esposas y a sus hijos y huyesen... mas hubo muchos que no quisieron dejarlos.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And the king of the Lamanites did go forth before his people... (Book of Mosiah 20)

traducciones.es: 26. Y el rey de los lamanitas hizo juramento a ellos de que su pueblo no los mataría. Y Limhi y su pueblo volvieron a la ciudad de Nefi, y comenzaron a morar de nuevo en la tierra en paz.

14. And they did humble themselves even in the depths of humility; and they did cry mightily to God; yea, even all the day long did they cry unto their God that he would deliver them out of their afflictions.

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And they did humble themselves even to the dust, subjecting... (Book of Mosiah 21)

14. Y se humillaron hasta el polvo, sujetándose al yugo de servidumbre, sometiéndose a ser heridos...
25. Y aconteció que el rey Limhi y su pueblo se regocijaron en extremo al saber que Ammón había venido de Zarahemla.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
11. And it came to pass that the people of king Limhi did depart by night into the wilderness with their flocks and their herds, and they went round about the land of Shilom in the wilderness, and bent their course towards the land of Zarahemla, being led by Ammon and his brethren.
13. And after being many days in the wilderness they arrived in the land of Zarahemla, and joined Mosiah's people, and became his subjects.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And the king hearkened unto the words of Gideon... And they... (Book of Mosiah 22)

traducciones.es:

capitulos.textoOriginal:
15. Thus did Alma teach his people, that every man should love his neighbor as himself, that there should be no contention among them.
21. Nevertheless the Lord seeth fit to chasten his people; yea, he trieth their patience and their faith.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And Alma and his people did prosper exceedingly in the land.... (Book of Mosiah 23)

traducciones.es:
15. Y Alma y su pueblo se establecieron en la tierra, y comenzaron a cultivar la tierra y a edificar edificios.
21. No obstante, el Señor juzga prudente disciplinar a su pueblo; sí, prueba su paciencia y su fe.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
14. And I will also ease the burdens which are put upon your shoulders, that even you cannot feel them upon your backs, even while you are in bondage; and this will I do that ye may stand as witnesses for me hereafter, and that ye may know of a surety that I, the Lord God, do visit my people in their afflictions.
15. And now it came to pass that the burdens which were laid upon Alma and his brethren were made light; yea, the Lord did strengthen them that they could bear up their burdens with ease, and they did submit cheerfully and with patience to all the will of the Lord.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I will also ease the burdens which are put upon your shoulde... (Book of Mosiah 24)

traducciones.es:
14. Y también aliviaré las cargas que se pongan sobre vuestros hombros, de manera que no las podáis sentir sobre vuestras espaldas, aun mientras estéis en servidumbre; y esto haré yo para que seáis mis testigos en lo futuro.
15. Y aconteció que las cargas que se imponían sobre Alma y sus hermanos se hicieron ligeras; sí, el Señor los fortaleció de modo que pudieron soportar sus cargas con facilidad, y se sometieron alegre y pacientemente a toda la voluntad del Señor.

capitulos.textoOriginal: 18. Therefore, Alma did go forth into the water and did baptize them; yea, he did baptize them after the manner he did his brethren in the waters of Mormon; yea, and as many as he did baptize did belong to the church of God; and this because of their belief on the words of Alma.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: And Mosiah did read, and also caused to be read, the records... (Book of Mosiah 25)

capitulos.textoOriginal:

Y el Señor me dijo: No te maravilles de que todo el género humano, sí, hombres y mujeres, toda nación, tribu, lengua y pueblo, deban nacer de nuevo; sí, nacer de Dios, ser cambiados de su estado carnal y caído, a un estado de rectitud, siendo redimidos por Dios, convirtiéndose en sus hijos e hijas.

capitulos.textoOriginal:

capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Therefore, choose you by the voice of this people, judges, t... (Book of Mosiah 29)

capitulos.textoOriginal: 22. And after he had anointed Coriantum to reign in his stead he lived four years, and he saw peace in the land; yea, and he even saw the Son of Righteousness, and did rejoice and glory in his day; and he died in peace.

Wherefore they did go into the land southward, to hunt food for the people of the land, for the land was covered with animals of the forest. And Lib also himself became a great hunter.

traducciones.es: 19. Y Lib fue un rey justo; e hicieron todo género de obras de oro, y de plata, y de hierro, y de bronce, y de todo género de metales.

capitulos.textoOriginal:
6. And now, I, Moroni, would speak somewhat concerning these things; I would show unto the world that faith is things which are hoped for and not seen; wherefore, dispute not because ye see not, for ye receive no witness until after the trial of your faith.

I give unto men weakness that they may be humble; and my grace is sufficient for all men that humble themselves before me; for if they humble themselves before me, and have faith in me, then will I make weak things become strong unto them.
41. And now, I would commend you to seek this Jesus of whom the prophets and apostles have written, that the grace of God the Father, and also the Lord Jesus Christ, and the Holy Ghost, which beareth record of them, may be and abide in you forever. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Faith is things which are hoped for and not seen; wherefore,... (Book of Ether 12)

6. Quisiera mostrar al mundo que la fe es las cosas que se esperan y no se ven; por tanto, no contendáis porque no veis, porque no recibís ningún testimonio sino hasta después de la prueba de vuestra fe.
27. Y si los hombres vienen a mí, les mostraré su debilidad. Doy a los hombres debilidad para que sean humildes; y basta mi gracia a todos los hombres que se humillan ante mí; porque si se humillan ante mí, y tienen fe en mí, entonces haré que las cosas débiles sean para ellos fuertes.
41. Y ahora bien, quisiera exhortaros a buscar a este Jesús de quien han escrito los profetas y apóstoles, a fin de que la gracia de Dios el Padre, y también del Señor Jesucristo, y del Santo Espíritu... esté y permanezca en vosotros para siempre.

3. And that it was the place of the New Jerusalem, which should come down out of heaven, and the holy sanctuary of the Lord.

30. And it came to pass that when Coriantumr had leaned upon his sword, that he rested a little, he smote off the head of Shiz.
33. And the Lord spake unto Ether, and said unto him: Go forth. And he went forth, and beheld that the words of the Lord had all been fulfilled; and he finished his record; (and the hundredth part I have not written) and he hid them in a manner that the people of Limhi did find them.
34. Now the last words which are written by Ether are these: Whether the Lord will that I be translated, or that I suffer the will of the Lord in the flesh, it mattereth not, if it so be that I am saved in the kingdom of God. Amen.

30. Y aconteció que cuando Coriantumr se hubo apoyado sobre su espada, y descansado un poco, le cortó la cabeza a Shiz.
33. Y el Señor habló a Éter y le dijo: Sal. Y salió, y vio que las palabras del Señor se habían cumplido todas.
34. Y si el Señor quisiere que yo sea trasladado, o que sufra la voluntad del Señor en la carne, no importa, con tal de que sea salvo en el reino de Dios. Amén.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 1: Moroni Escribe para el Beneficio de los Lamanitas

capitulos.textoOriginal:
1. Now I, Moroni, after having made an end of abridging the account of the people of Jared, I had supposed not to have written more, but I have not as yet perished; and I make not myself known to the Lamanites lest they should destroy me.
3. And I, Moroni, will not deny the Christ; wherefore, I wander whithersoever I can for the safety of mine own life.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: I, Moroni, after having made an end of abridging the account... (Book of Moroni 1)

traducciones.es:
1. Yo, Moroni, habiendo concluido la relación del pueblo de Jared, no había pensado escribir más; pero todavía no he perecido.
3. Por tanto, escribo unas cuantas cosas más, contrario a lo que había supuesto... para que quizás sean de valor para mis hermanos los lamanitas en algún día futuro, según la voluntad del Señor.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 2: La Ordenanza de Conferir el Don del Espíritu Santo
capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal:
1. The words of Christ, which he spake unto his disciples, the twelve whom he had chosen, as he laid his hands upon them—
2. And he called them by name, saying: Ye shall call on the Father in my name, in mighty prayer; and after ye have done this ye shall have power that to him upon whom ye shall lay your hands, ye shall give the Holy Ghost; and in my name shall ye give it, for thus do mine apostles.

1. Las palabras de Cristo que habló a sus doce discípulos cuando les impuso las manos:
2. Los llamó por sus nombres, diciendo: Invocaréis al Padre en mi nombre, con potente oración; y después de haber hecho esto, tendréis poder para dar el Espíritu Santo a aquel sobre quien impusiereis las manos; y en mi nombre lo daréis, porque así lo hacen mis apóstoles.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 3: La Ordenación de Sacerdotes y Maestros
capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal:

3. In the name of Jesus Christ I ordain you to be a priest (or if he be a teacher, I ordain you to be a teacher) to preach repentance and remission of sins through Jesus Christ, by the endurance of faith on his name to the end. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The manner which the disciples, who were called the elders o... (Book of Moroni 3)

traducciones.es:
1. La manera en que los discípulos, que eran llamados los élderes de la iglesia, ordenaban presbíteros y maestros:
3. En el nombre de Jesucristo te ordeno para ser presbítero (o si era maestro: te ordeno para ser maestro), para predicar el arrepentimiento y la remisión de pecados mediante Jesucristo, por la fe en su nombre hasta el fin. Amén.

capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal: 3. O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it; that they may eat in remembrance of the body of thy Son, and witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon them the name of thy Son, and always remember him, and keep his commandments which he hath given them, that they may always have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The manner of their elders and priests administering the fle... (Book of Moroni 4)

traducciones.es: 3. ¡Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, te pedimos en el nombre de tu Hijo, Jesucristo, que bendigas y santifiques este pan para las almas de todos los que participen de él, para que lo coman en memoria del cuerpo de tu Hijo, y testifiquen ante ti, oh Dios, Padre Eterno, que están dispuestos a tomar sobre sí el nombre de tu Hijo, y a recordarle siempre, y a guardar sus mandamientos que él les ha dado, para que siempre puedan tener su Espíritu consigo! Amén.

capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal: 2. O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee, in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this wine to the souls of all those who drink of it, that they may do it in remembrance of the blood of thy Son, which was shed for them; that they may witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they do always remember him, that they may have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: The manner of administering the wine... O God, the Eternal F... (Book of Moroni 5)

traducciones.es: 2. ¡Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, te pedimos en el nombre de tu Hijo, Jesucristo, que bendigas y santifiques este vino para las almas de todos los que beban de él, para que lo hagan en memoria de la sangre de tu Hijo, que se derramó por ellos; para que testifiquen ante ti, oh Dios, Padre Eterno, que siempre se acuerdan de él, para que puedan tener su Espíritu consigo! Amén.

4. And after they had been received unto baptism, and were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ; and their names were taken, that they might be remembered and nourished by the good word of God, to keep them in the right way, to keep them continually watchful unto prayer, relying alone upon the merits of Christ, who was the author and the finisher of their faith.
5. And the church did meet together oft, to fast and to pray, and to speak one with another concerning the welfare of their souls.

4. Y después de haber sido recibidos por el bautismo... eran contados entre el pueblo de la iglesia de Cristo; y sus nombres eran inscritos, para que fuesen recordados y nutridos por la buena palabra de Dios.
5. Y la iglesia se reunía con frecuencia para ayunar y orar, y para hablar unos con otros concerniente al bienestar de sus almas.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 7: El Sublime Discurso de Mormón sobre la Fe, la Esperanza y la Caridad
capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal:
45. And charity suffereth long, and is kind, and envieth not, and is not puffed up, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil, and rejoiceth not in iniquity but rejoiceth in the truth, beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
46. Wherefore, my beloved brethren, if ye have not charity, ye are nothing, for charity never faileth. Wherefore, cleave unto charity, which is the greatest of all, for all things must fail—
47. But charity is the pure love of Christ, and it endureth forever; and whoso is found possessed of it at the last day, it shall be well with him.
48. Wherefore, my beloved brethren, pray unto the Father with all the energy of heart, that ye may be filled with this love, which he hath bestowed upon all who are true followers of his Son, Jesus Christ; that ye may become the sons of God; that when he shall appear we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is; that we may have this hope; that we may be purified even as he is pure. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Charity is the pure love of Christ, and it endureth forever;... (Book of Moroni 7)

traducciones.es:
45. Y la caridad es sufrida, y es benigna, y no tiene envidia, ni se ensalza, no busca lo suyo, no se irrita fácilmente, no piensa el mal, no se regocija en la iniquidad, sino que se regocija en la verdad; todo lo sufre, todo lo cree, todo lo espera, todo lo soporta.
46. De modo que, mis amados hermanos, si no tenéis caridad, nada sois, porque la caridad nunca deja de ser. Por tanto, allegaos a la caridad, que es la mayor de todas, porque todas las cosas han de perecer;
47. mas la caridad es el amor puro de Cristo, y permanece para siempre; y a quien la posea en el postrer día, le irá bien.
48. Por consiguiente, amados hermanos míos, pedid al Padre con toda la energía de vuestros corazones, que seáis llenos de este amor que él ha otorgado a todos los que son discípulos verdaderos de su Hijo Jesucristo; para que lleguéis a ser hijos de Dios; para que cuando él aparezca, seamos semejantes a él, porque lo veremos tal como es.

capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal:
8. Listen to the words of Christ, your Redeemer, your Lord and your God. Behold, I came into the world not to call the righteous but sinners to repentance; the whole need no physician, but they that are sick; wherefore, little children are whole, for they are not capable of committing sin; wherefore the curse of Adam is taken from them in me, that it hath no power over them; and the law of circumcision is done away in me.
22. For behold that all little children are alive in Christ, and also all they that are without the law. For the power of redemption cometh on all them that have no law; wherefore, he that is not condemned, or he that is under no condemnation, cannot repent; and unto such baptism availeth nothing—
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: Little children are whole, for they are not capable of commi... (Book of Moroni 8)

traducciones.es:
8. Escucha las palabras de Cristo, tu Redentor, tu Señor y tu Dios: He aquí, no vine al mundo a llamar a los justos al arrepentimiento, sino a los pecadores... por tanto, los niños pequeños son sanos, porque son incapaces de cometer pecado.
22. Porque he aquí, todos los niños pequeños viven en Cristo, y también todos aquellos que están sin ley. Porque el poder de la redención surte efecto en todos los que no tienen ley.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 9: La Segunda Epístola de Mormón: La Gracia de Cristo en Medio de la Prueba
capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal: 25. My son, be faithful in Christ; and may not the things which I have written grieve thee, to weigh thee down unto death; but may Christ lift thee up, and may his sufferings and death, and the showing his body unto our fathers, and his mercy and long-suffering, and the hope of his glory and of eternal life, rest in your mind forever.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: My son, be faithful in Christ; and may not the things which... (Book of Moroni 9)

traducciones.es: 25. Hijo mío, sé fiel en Cristo; y que las cosas que he escrito no te aflijan, para pesarte hasta la muerte; sino que Cristo te anime, y sus padecimientos y muerte, y la manifestación de su cuerpo a nuestros padres, y su misericordia y longanimidad, y la esperanza de su gloria y de la vida eterna, reposen en tu mente para siempre.

capitulos.capitulo: Libro de Moroni · Capítulo 10: La Promesa de Moroni y la Despedida Final: «Venid a Cristo»
capitulos.seccion: Testimonio Final y Sellamiento de Moroni
capitulos.textoOriginal:
4. And when ye shall receive these things, I would exhort you that ye would ask God, the Eternal Father, in the name of Christ, if these things are not true; and if ye shall ask with a sincere heart, with real intent, having faith in Christ, he will manifest the truth of it unto you, by the power of the Holy Ghost.
5. And by the power of the Holy Ghost ye may know the truth of all things.
32. Yea, come unto Christ, and be perfected in him, and deny yourselves of all ungodliness; and if ye shall deny yourselves of all ungodliness, and love God with all your might, mind and strength, then is his grace sufficient for you, that by his grace ye may be perfect in Christ; and if by the grace of God ye are perfect in Christ, ye can in nowise deny the power of God.
34. And now I bid unto all, farewell. I soon go to rest in the paradise of God, until my spirit and body shall again reunite, and I am brought forth triumphant through the air, to meet you before the pleasing bar of the great Jehovah, the Eternal Judge of both quick and dead. Amen.
capitulos.foneticaLiturgica: When ye shall receive these things, I would exhort you that... (Book of Moroni 10)

traducciones.es:
4. Y cuando recibáis estas cosas, quisiera exhortaros a que preguntéis a Dios el Eterno Padre, en el nombre de Cristo, si no son verdaderas estas cosas; y si pedís con un corazón sincero, con verdadera intención, teniendo fe en Cristo, él os manifestará la verdad de ellas por el poder del Espíritu Santo.
5. Y por el poder del Espíritu Santo podréis conocer la verdad de todas las cosas.
32. Sí, venid a Cristo, y perfeccionaos en él, y absteneos de toda impiedad; y si os abstenéis de toda impiedad, y amáis a Dios con toda vuestra alma, mente y fuerza, entonces su gracia os es suficiente, para que por su gracia seáis perfectos en Cristo.
34. Y ahora me despido de todos. Pronto iré a descansar en el paraíso de Dios, hasta que mi espíritu y mi cuerpo de nuevo se reúnan, y triunfante sea llevado por el aire, para encontraros ante el placentero tribunal del gran Jehová, el Juez Eterno de vivos y muertos. Amén.
